summary.rho_statistic: exact tie-averaged Spearman (phi fast path when the witness field is binary)
summary.definitions: forward_overlap = fraction of MY dots within 3 px of the witness's dots (gems57.uniqueness.dot_overlap); reverse_overlap = fraction of the witness's dots within 3 px of mine; E = fraction of the footprint within 3 px of the witness's dots; lift = (observed - E) / (1 - E).
